newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp to invest 10 bln yen to make new LCD--paper.
newsitem.headline: Sharp to invest 10 bln yen to make new LCD--paper.

text.p: Sharp Corp plans 10 billion yen worth of investment to start production of liquid crystal displays (LCDs) made with low-temperature polysilicon by the summer of 1998, a Japanese business daily reported on Thursday.
The company will use an existing production line at its factory in western Japan to make 50,000 sheets of the new LCDs per month, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
The new type of thin film transistor LCD can process image data more quickly than the usual amorphus silicon LCDs.
A spokesman for Sharp was not immediately available to comment on the report.
